articles.title: A Total Solar Eclipse Will Sweep Across Europe—Watch It Live From Spain
articles.summary: On August 12, a total solar eclipse will darken a path from Greenland to Spain. ESA will broadcast the event live from the Javalambre observatory, offering telescope views and expert commentary. Totality there will last 1 minute and 21 seconds.

articles.title: How Ancient Potato Farming May Have Rewired Andean DNA
articles.summary: A study reveals that Indigenous Peruvians carry an unusually high number of AMY1 gene copies, which aids starch digestion. Researchers link this to natural selection after potato domestication 6,000–10,000 years ago. They average 10 copies, more than any other population.

articles.title: SpaceX Launches 29 Starlink Satellites, Booster Logs 18th Flight
articles.summary: On August 11, SpaceX launched 29 Starlink satellites from Florida, marking the 93rd Falcon 9 mission this year. The first-stage booster, B1085, completed its 18th landing on a drone ship. Starlink now has over 10,900 active satellites in orbit.
